description: This file defines a trait SparkFileUtils providing utility methods for file operations such as resolving URIs, listing files, creating directories, deleting files, moving and copying files, and other file manipulations within the Apache Spark project.

methods.name: resolveURI
methods.description: Converts a user input string into a well-formed URI, handling relative paths and fragments.

methods.name: sizeOf
methods.description: Returns the size of a file or directory recursively.

methods.name: recursiveList
methods.description: Lists all files recursively within a directory.

methods.name: listFiles
methods.description: Lists all regular files recursively.

methods.name: listPaths
methods.description: Lists all paths recursively.

methods.name: createDirectory
methods.description: Creates a directory at the specified path.

methods.name: createTempDir
methods.description: Creates a temporary directory in the system temp directory.

methods.name: createParentDirs
methods.description: Creates parent directories for a given file.

methods.name: cleanDirectory
methods.description: Deletes contents of a directory without deleting the directory itself.

methods.name: deleteRecursively
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory and its contents recursively.

methods.name: deleteQuietly
methods.description: Deletes a file or directory quietly without throwing exceptions.

methods.name: forceDeleteOnExit
methods.description: Registers a file or directory for deletion on JVM exit.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Constructs a File object from a sequence of path components.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Constructs a File object from a parent File and path components.

methods.name: moveFile
methods.description: Moves a file from source to destination.

methods.name: moveDirectory
methods.description: Moves a directory from source to destination.

methods.name: copyDirectory
methods.description: Copies a directory to a target location.

methods.name: copyFileToDirectory
methods.description: Copies a file into a directory.

methods.name: copyFile
methods.description: Copies a file to a destination.

methods.name: copyURLToFile
methods.description: Copies content from a URL to a file.

methods.name: contentEquals
methods.description: Checks if two files have the same content.

methods.name: touch
methods.description: Updates the last modified time of a file or creates it if it does not exist.
